ns2:section.sectionText: A limited number of seats will continue to open throughout November. Should the course be full when attempting to register, it is suggested that students "favorite" the course through the Course Explorer and request email notifications from the system about open seats. They often become available through the 10th day of courses. Please note: This course will be taught asynchronous (no live sessions). See the syllabus for course details. Students may not enroll in JOUR 200 and JOUR 210 in the same semester. Day1Access course materials cost $34.31. For more information see https://go.illinois.edu/Day1Access.
